classification.behavior_change_summary: Introduces an arg-mode feature (MIN_MODE, arg_val) enabling arguments to be evaluated/valued against targets, and makes Coalesce defaults and recursive repr handling use it; broad behavior changes across glom, matching, and mutation.

tasks.title: Enable argument evaluation against targets in glom constructs

classification.behavior_change_summary: PathAccessError no longer crashes when formatting an error message for a Path whose path/part index cannot be resolved; it now falls back to showing the whole path instead of raising AttributeError/IndexError.

provenance.message: Keep PathAccessError printable for Scope/S paths (#249) (#298)

tasks.title: Fix PathAccessError message formatting for non-Path and out-of-range paths

classification.behavior_change_summary: Improves the error message raised when accessing a dunder attribute on a T spec, telling the user the exact attribute name and how to access it via `T.__()`. The exception type and behavior are unchanged.

provenance.message: more specific T dunder attribute error message

tasks.title: Improve T dunder attribute error message

classification.behavior_change_summary: Check now returns its configured default when a validator function raises the validation error type, instead of only handling non-validation exceptions; previously failing validators wouldn't trigger the default return.

provenance.message: add STOP support to Check tests, fix a bug in Check where failing validator functions wouldn't trigger the returning of the default

tasks.title: Check default should apply when validator raises validation error

classification.behavior_change_summary: Match mode now re-raises exceptions raised by a callable spec as MatchError, and distinguishes a non-truthy return, so validation failures are reported as MatchError instead of leaking arbitrary exceptions.

provenance.message: glom Match re-raises errors as MatchError

tasks.title: Match mode should wrap callable exceptions and non-truthy returns as MatchError

classification.behavior_change_summary: Fixes the repr/formatting of T/S specs containing slice indices so that slices render like `[1:2]` instead of using the default slice repr. The string representation of T/S expressions with slices is now more readable.

tasks.title: Fix slice repr in T and S expressions
